    context = None

        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Navigate to the 'Shipments' page to verify access to another protected route.
        frame = context.pages[-1]

        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/div[2]/div/div[2]/div/div[2]/div[2]/ul/li/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)
        

        # -> Navigate to the 'Settings' page to verify access to another protected route.
        frame = context.pages[-1]
        # Click on the 'Settings' link to verify access to the protected Settings route
        elem = frame.locator('xpath=html/body/div[2]/div/div[2]/div/div[2]/div[4]/ul/li[2]/a').nth(0)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000); await elem.click(timeout=5000)

        await expect(frame.locator('text=Settings').first).to_be_visible(timeout=30000)

            await context.close()

            await browser.close()
        if pw:
            await pw.stop()
            
asyncio.run(run_test())
